In fig. 2.1, A, B and C are three population pyramids. Study their shapes and answer the questions that follow.

Pyramid (A): the bars are longest at the 0-5 band and shorten steadily at every higher age band, tapering to a very narrow apex above 80.

Pyramid (B): the bars are short at the base, widen upward, are longest in the 55-70 bands, and then taper to the apex.

Pyramid (C): the bars are of almost equal length from the base up to about age 60, after which they shorten towards the apex.
